spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates §13.2 directly — display-p3-linear as a <rectangular-color-space> for gradients and color-mix() — with per-space probes of the exact gradient and color-mix declarations, and quotes the spec's own physically-mixing-lights rationale.

interactive.rationale: Two color inputs, three endpoint presets, and a mix-share slider drive four gradient strips and a four-row color-mix table of real getComputedStyle values; CDP verified strip re-render on preset change and table rebuild at 25%.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index promises four-space side-by-side interpolation with srgb-linear as the shipping control; the page is exactly that, and the control genuinely runs on pre-144 browsers.

edge_cases.rationale: The unsupported space is probed per-declaration (gradient and color-mix separately), reported with both probe results in the banner, hatched in the strip, and named in its table row — no lookalike fill anywhere.

references.rationale: chromestatus entry, §13.2 and §10.5 anchors linked; the sibling out-of-gamut concept cross-linked.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite pins both interpolation contracts this page demonstrates (color-mix and gradient 'in display-p3-linear') as separate css-supports assertions with spec anchors.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP on Chromium 141: three of four strips render natively (srgb, srgb-linear, display-p3 — real computed gradients read back), color-mix rows resolve with real serialized values (e.g. color(srgb-linear 0.25 0.263635 4.2e-9) at 25%), zero console errors, screenshots read at both viewports. NOT verified: the display-p3-linear strip/row itself, which needs Chrome 144+.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts strip render count and, on the fallback branch, p3-linear-color-mix-unsupported-branch explicitly; supported browsers instead assert all four rows resolved.

design_system.rationale: Variables throughout; live tags are black-on-ivory inverted pair, unsupported tags rose-on-ivory with border (AA); hatch uses stone/paper.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled color inputs and slider, role=group presets, aria-live readout summarising how many spaces rendered, strips exposed as role=img whose names state either the interpolation performed or that nothing rendered, table with caption that restates the current mix percentage.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800: zero horizontal overflow; strips are full-width blocks, the mix table scrolls in its own container, endpoint controls wrap.

openQuestions.title: Verify all four spaces resolve on Chrome 144+
openQuestions.detail: On this build only srgb, srgb-linear and display-p3 could be exercised natively. A Chrome 144+ pass should confirm the fourth strip paints, the color-mix row serializes as color(display-p3-linear …), the readout reports 4 of 4, and the all-resolved telemetry assert fires.

openQuestions.title: Consider an XYZ row for the spec's full linear-light list
openQuestions.detail: §13.2 names CIE XYZ alongside display-p3-linear and srgb-linear as appropriate for physically mixing lights. A fifth row interpolating in xyz-d65 (shipped) would complete the spec's own list and let visitors compare the two linear spaces' gamut difference against the reference space. Additive only.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive comparison strips full-width rows mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer stacking full-width rows with wrapping control clusters over multi-column comparisons that force horizontal overflow on narrow screens.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each interpolation space is a full-width strip row that stacks naturally; endpoint pickers and presets sit in a flex-wrap cluster; the value table gets its own scroller.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP overflow check: 360px scrollWidth == clientWidth; mobile screenshot read with all four strips full-width and legible.

guidanceConsulted.query: announce state of visual gradient comparison non-visually
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Pair purely visual output with text equivalents: state-bearing accessible names and a live-region summary.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every strip's role=img name states its space and whether it rendered; the aria-live readout counts rendered spaces and explains the hatched strip; each table row prints the browser's serialized mixed color as text.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP read the readout after a preset swap: '3 of 4 interpolation spaces rendered natively for #0000ff → #ffd000…'.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Feature-detect each declaration you actually ship, not a proxy for it.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Gradient support and color-mix support are probed as two separate exact CSS.supports calls per space, because an engine could ship one without the other; both results are printed in the banner.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Banner on 141 shows both probes false for display-p3-linear while the other six probes pass and their UI runs natively.

summary: Practical/advanced concept: the reason the space exists, shown as four simultaneous interpolations with real per-space probes and real computed values. Because srgb-linear and display-p3 already ship, the comparison is genuinely live on pre-144 browsers, and the new space's row is the only honestly-hatched one. CDP-verified on Chromium 141 at both viewports with a clean console.
